items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Montes Claros (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Nov 25, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
